bull_bear.body:
- Net worth of ₹38,973 Cr with a capital adequacy ratio of 20.30% (Tier-1 19.39%, Tier-2 0.91%); book value per share of ₹970.70 at Jun-26.
- Dividend per equity share stated as "300% at ₹30"; the deck's at-a-glance slide mixes Q1 FY2027 and FY 2026 period tags, so the exact period for this figure is not recoverable from the extract.
- Standalone capital gearing of 3.59x at Jun-26 on tangible net worth of ₹389,706 Mn against outside liabilities of ₹1,533,268 Mn, with cash and cash equivalents & bank balances of ₹134,193 Mn.
- Deliberately diversified funding: Borrowings from Banks/FIs ₹646,058 Mn (43%), Secured Non-Convertible Debentures–Listed ₹510,752 Mn (34%), External Commercial Bonds–Senior Secured Notes ₹260,322 Mn (17%), Commercial Paper ₹60,834 Mn (4%), Other Loans ₹9,149 Mn (1%) and Subordinated Debt–Listed ₹4,500 Mn (0%).
- Provisioning is held above the modelled requirement — an excess provision outstanding in books of ₹2,954 Mn is carried unchanged at Jun-26, Mar-26 and Jun-25 — alongside ECL provision at 1.03% of loan assets and Stage III at 2.28%.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "India's Largest Gold Loan NBFC, Anchored in Trust" — uniquely focused since 1939 on gold-secured lending and recognised by the Reserve Bank of India as an Upper Layer NBFC.
- Claims a 47% gold loan market share among NBFCs (primary source: CRISIL Industry Report on Gold Loans, January 2026 update) and ranks #1 in the TRA Brand Trust Report as India's Most Trusted Financial Services Brand for ten consecutive years.
- Single-product depth is presented as the moat: "Our systems, processes and people of the Company are built around this single product", supported by strong underwriting standards (ownership verification, gold valuation, ticket-size protocols) and quick, minimal-TAT disbursal.
- In-house capability is explicit — internal audit, branch security, valuation, technology and collections are "built and operated in-house" — with training delivered through Regional Learning Centres and Muthoot Management Academies.
- Portfolio is 92% secured by gold, and the group is promoter-led with 73.35% promoter group shareholding; management frames the discipline as "for growth to last, it must be balanced with prudence".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Regulation] The Managing Director states that "the regulator provided the industry with a clearer foundation for growth", but the deck does not name the regulation or quantify its impact.
- [Market size] The organised gold loan market (banks and NBFCs combined) is projected at ₹16 Lakh Cr for FY 2026, growing 33 to 36% on-year over FY 2025's ₹12 Lakh Cr, per the CRISIL January 2026 update.
- [Untapped collateral] Total household gold in India is cited at 34,600 tonnes (IBEF) against only 2,950-3,350 tonnes currently used as collateral (CRISIL) — the headroom argument underpinning the growth case.
- [Subsidiary turnaround] Belstar Microfinance swung to a profit after tax of ₹661 Mn in Q1 FY2027 against a loss of ₹1,280 Mn in Q1 FY2026, with Stage III assets falling to 2.85% of gross loan assets from 5.54% at Mar-26.
- [Brand campaign] Flagship campaign "Sunheri Soch" is in its fourth season ('Garv Ka Parv'), run in 8 languages with 100% new branches covered; the current campaign "Sona Kya Nahi Kar Sakta" is fronted by Shri Amitabh Bachchan.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Muthoot Finance as India's largest gold loan NBFC — an RBI-recognised Upper Layer NBFC with roots to 1887 and gold lending since 1939 — whose moat is a single-product operating system (branch density, in-house valuation/audit/security, brand trust) riding a structural shift of household gold from informal moneylenders into formal, working-capital credit.
